ui.camino_contribuir_corpus: The signed pairs that come through this door, one at a time, after a person has looked at them. Nothing publishes itself.
ui.camino_contribuir_falla: Closed. The Agora hasn't moderated yet, and opening writing without moderation is opening a spam inbox.
ui.camino_contribuir_frase: Return to the common what you've measured: pairs signed that train the next version.
ui.camino_contribuir_papel: It believes you know what you are handing over and that you mean to. It asks you for nothing: it shows you what leaves your device and under which signature, and waits for you to decide.
ui.camino_contribuir_para_quien: For those who have climbed the four steps and want to leave something behind.
ui.camino_despertar_corpus: The first-visit conversations already held in the rack, plus every correction you sign from this floor.
ui.camino_despertar_falla: No memory: closing the tab leaves nothing behind. And without a network, no corrections reach the rack.
ui.camino_despertar_frase: Put the device in airplane mode and keep talking. What it responds is already in your browser.
ui.camino_despertar_papel: It believes this is the first time you have spoken to it and that you do not trust it. It has not been told your name or your level: only that you are on a phone and might leave in thirty seconds. If you ask for something that needs the network, it is under orders to say so rather than pretend.
ui.camino_despertar_para_quien: For those who still don't believe it works without someone on the other side.
ui.camino_exposicion_corpus: Real output pasted here, with anything private redacted on your own device before anything is stored.
ui.camino_exposicion_falla: The browser doesn't execute anything. If you don't paste the output, there's no measurement — and validating line by line takes time.
ui.camino_exposicion_frase: Defensive OSINT about yourself. You run the commands; the page only reads what you paste.
ui.camino_exposicion_papel: It believes you are at a terminal on YOUR machine and that you run the commands. It executes nothing: it reads what you paste. If you paste output it does not understand, it is under orders to say so rather than half-interpret it.
ui.camino_exposicion_para_quien: For those who want to know what others see of them without installing a tool that looks inside.
ui.camino_killswitch_corpus: Complete account-closure walkthroughs on real platforms, with their date and with whatever failed along the way.
ui.camino_killswitch_falla: Cutting off does not erase what has already been released. The switch stops the flow, it does not recover the water. And some platforms take weeks, ask for more data to delete you, or simply do not comply.
ui.camino_killswitch_frase: Practice cutting off. Choose ONE real account and go through the entire process: revoke permissions, export what is yours, close, check a week later. Write down how long it took and what remained.
ui.camino_killswitch_papel: It believes you have already measured your exposure and that you are cutting ONE real account, not rehearsing. It is under orders to tell you what cutting does NOT undo before giving you the first step.
ui.camino_killswitch_para_quien: For those who have measured their exposure and want to know how much of it they can truly undo.
ui.camino_primeros_pasos_corpus: The prompts people actually write on this site, paired with the rewritten version their author accepted.
ui.camino_primeros_pasos_falla: The judge corrects the prompt, not the model: if the model is small, it will remain small.
ui.camino_primeros_pasos_frase: Your local AI doesn't know about PreceptorOS. Here, we study how a greeting turns into a test.
ui.camino_primeros_pasos_papel: It believes you already have a model running on your machine and that you do not know what to ask it. It does not know which one or what size: if it needs that, it has to ask you, not assume.
ui.camino_primeros_pasos_para_quien: For those who already have a model running and don't know what to ask it.
ui.camino_puertos_corpus: Port lists pasted here alongside the explanation the person accepted as good, and the ones they rejected.
ui.camino_puertos_falla: An open port is not a breach: almost all of them are yours and necessary. This gives you the list, not the verdict. Deciding which ones are unnecessary is the job, and no one can do it for you without knowing how you use the device.
ui.camino_puertos_frase: Before asking who is watching you from the outside, look at what is speaking from within your machine. List what is listening on your own machine: `ss -ltn` on Linux, `netstat -an` on Windows and macOS, a network app on mobile. Note which process each port belongs to.
ui.camino_puertos_papel: It believes you are bringing it the port list of your own machine and that you want to understand each one. It does not know your operating system until you tell it. It is forbidden from calling an open port a breach: almost all of them are yours and needed.
ui.camino_puertos_para_quien: For those who have never looked at which programs on their own device are speaking to the network while they are not looking.
ui.camino_silencio_corpus: Whole ten-minute rounds, with what was asked and with what went unanswered.
ui.camino_silencio_falla: It can be lost, and lost track: the defeat is signed the same as the victory.
ui.camino_silencio_frase: Ten minutes with battery as the only pressure. The clock is real and doesn't pause.
ui.camino_silencio_papel: It believes you are offline with the clock running. It cannot look anything up or promise to check later: whatever it does not know it says now, which is the only useful answer with six minutes left.
ui.camino_silencio_para_quien: For those who want to know what they have left when the network goes down.
ui.camino_whoami_corpus: Self-search sessions with personal data redacted before storage. What trains is the method, not who you are.
ui.camino_whoami_falla: Only works for finding YOU. Doing it with someone else's name is not learning: it is exactly what this step exists for you to recognize when it is done to you. And finding a data point does not erase it.
ui.camino_whoami_frase: Find yourself. Your name, your email, your phone number, your address. A search engine, a couple of data aggregators, and known leaks. Note what comes out, where it comes from, and what consent you signed to let it out.
ui.camino_whoami_papel: It believes the person searching and the person being searched for are the SAME. That is the condition of this floor: if it detects you asking it to look up someone else, it is under orders to stop and say why, not to do it badly.
ui.camino_whoami_para_quien: For those who accepted a thousand pages of data processing without reading any, which is all of us.
ui.torre_anfitrion: You are the host of PreceptorOS. Someone is talking to you from a phone and may not know what this is. Answer in English, three sentences at most, and end with ONE question that gives them the next step. No brochure enthusiasm and no emoji.
ui.torre_guia_no_data: No data came out, and that's also a step. How could this AI guide better in what you just tried?
ui.torre_hechos: PreceptorOS is not an operating system or a Linux distribution: it is a companion that runs models on YOUR machine. This site is only the door. The chat on this page is answered by the rack —a few small machines in a house—, not a cloud. Nothing is published without a person looking at it. If you do not know something, say NO_DATA: inventing it here is worse than not having it.
ui.torre_lema: It is practiced, signed, and ascended. No step compels the next.
ui.torre_no_enviado: It stays on your device until you send it:

pendiente.papel_de_usuario: NO_DATA · falta escribir con quien cree el modelo que habla en cada peldano. Se escribe en castellano y se traduce a las ocho, como el resto; hasta entonces el desplegable lo declara en pantalla.
